name: prd-ownership-deny-claude
doc: Claim contract (order-independent, one slot per agent). A sub-agent typed backend-expert first writes ITS OWN report slot (allowed, binds for the session), then tries to Write another slot's report (prd/agents/backend-expert-2-prd.json) -> PreToolUse deny with prompt.title 'PRD ownership' (renders '[BLOCKED] PRD ownership'). Same intent as before (an agent never writes a second slot); only the setup changed: a -2 slot may now be claimed FIRST by any same-type agent, so the deny is asserted once the agent already owns a slot. Without the PRD gate the second step would be denied by protectedPathGuard ('Protected path') instead, so the 'PRD ownership' title proves the PRD gate ran.

steps.doc: backend-expert claims its own slot (open: no report on disk yet) -> allowed and bound for the session.
The SAME agent_id now reaches for backend-expert-2's report file -> denied (one slot per agent).
